text:
ana: quick note: ops reports banner fatigue from v1 sunset. can we pilot hiding deprecation banners for a few tenants while still collecting telemetry?

sam: clarify: UI-only hide, telemetry/quota unchanged?

ana: yes, UI-only. we must keep telemetry and billing signals.

kai: propose metric `api.deprecations.silenced` with tenant tag so we can measure impact separately.

margo: console UX: a small badge next to version that opens a modal to "Temporarily hide deprecation". modal shows billing preview + expiry.

dave: trivial proxy passthrough: preserve header `X-Redwood-Deprec-Silence: true` and emit access log entry. I'll open a tiny PR.

sam: add two alerts: usage spike for silenced tenants (>2x baseline) and cohort lag if >80% still on v1 after 30d.

deploy-bot: deploy started for proxy PR 3344 by dave  canary to 3 hosts
